summary: The fallback warning can be ignored or silenced with ansible_python_interpreter=auto_silent, as shown in an inventory example.
questions: How do I silence the interpreter discovery warning?

answer_card.title: Silence the interpreter warning
answer_card.answer_md:
Set:
```ini
ansible_python_interpreter=auto_silent
```
alongside your `ansible_interpreter_python_fallback`. Discovery still happens, without the warning.
